How do I get to Joker Tattoo in Patong?
We are at 91 Nanai Road in Patong. Open our location in Google Maps for directions from anywhere in Patong or Phuket, or contact the studio if you need help finding us.
Do I need to book, or can I walk in?
We recommend booking so we can match your idea with the right Tattoo Artist and allow enough time to prepare. Walk-ins depend on availability, so it is best to contact the studio before you visit.
How should I prepare for my tattoo?

Come well rested, hydrated and after a proper meal. Avoid alcohol before your appointment, wear comfortable clothing that gives easy access to the placement, and follow any guidance from your Tattoo Artist.
How should I care for my new tattoo?
Your Tattoo Artist will give you aftercare instructions suited to your tattoo and skin. Follow them carefully, keep the area clean and contact the studio if you have any questions while it heals.
What is the difference between machine and bamboo tattooing?

Machine tattooing uses an electric tattoo machine for precise, consistent lines, shading and colour. Bamboo tattooing is done by hand with a traditional tool, creating a different rhythm and finish. The right method depends on your design, placement and preferred result; our Tattoo Artists will guide you.
How much does a tattoo cost?
The price depends on size, placement, style, detail and the time required. Share your idea with us and, after a Consultation, the studio can provide a clear estimate before you book.
